name: Northsand, Inc.
summary: Northsand, Inc. provides IT consulting and business consulting services in Japan and internationally. The company offers various services from IT strategy and planning to implementation and operations, including design considerations and reducing IT operating costs. It also provides business improvement, strategy formulation, and execution support in non-IT areas, such as marketing, sales, and human resources; and provision of Notion services. Northsand, Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Chuo, Japan.
